_doc: Numbers for the 08-two-queries center chart. Swap this file to change the chart (1 or 2 rows, 3 columns). Big number = buffer accesses at the root node; small = execution time, median of measured passes x 3 restores, warm cache. 'drop.col' = column where the badge sits (1 = between col 0 and 1, 2 = between col 1 and 2); 'drop.at' = seconds after the row appears.
